records.source: **CORUM % and KEGG %**, the share of clusters with at least one enriched group: a two-sided Fisher exact test for every group in every cluster, Benjamini-Hochberg within the cluster, enriched at FDR < 0.05. The background is every clustered row, non-targeting rows included. Two variants are reported: ``may2025`` counts every member of a group (Brieflow's release of May 2025, which reproduces Funk et al.'s 24.3 % and 13.5 %) and ``head`` only the members in the background (Brieflow's current code).
records.translation: **CORUM % e KEGG %**, a fração de clusters com pelo menos um grupo enriquecido: um teste exato de Fisher bilateral para cada grupo em cada cluster, Benjamini-Hochberg dentro do cluster, enriquecido com FDR < 0,05. records.context: :func:`spacr.gene_measurement_compare.mitotic_calls` calls a cell mitotic with a fixed rule on nuclear DNA intensity and area. On plate A of Funk et al. 2022 the per-gene mitotic index from that rule correlates with Funk et al.'s at Spearman rho = 0.32 only. records.label: spacr.ops_mitotic#1
records.source: :func:`spacr.gene_measurement_compare.mitotic_calls` calls a cell mitotic with a fixed rule on nuclear DNA intensity and area. records.translation: :func:`spacr.gene_measurement_compare.mitotic_calls` classifica uma célula como mitótica com uma regra fixa sobre a intensidade de DNA e a área nucleares. Na placa A de Funk et al. 2022, o índice mitótico por gene obtido com essa regra se correlaciona com o de Funk et al. com Spearman rho = 0,32 apenas. Funk et al. treinaram, em vez disso, um classificador com características de DNA e tubulina; este módulo faz o mesmo com células rotuladas.

As funções aqui são uma reimplementação limpa das suas etapas ``centerscale_by_batch``, ``embed_by_pca`` e ``tvn_on_controls``, escritas para que o resultado possa ser conferido valor a valor com ela.

records.context: The steps, with the batch being the microplate sample position:
records.label: spacr.ops_tvn#2
records.source: The steps, with the batch being the well:
records.translation: As etapas, sendo o lote o poço:

records.context: 1. columns with more than ``max_nonfinite`` non-finite values are dropped and the remaining gaps are filled with the column median; 2. every batch is centred and scaled on all of its cells; 3. a PCA keeping ``pca_variance`` of the variance is fitted on a random sample of ``pca_sample`` cells (seed ``seed``) and every cell is projected; 4. the projection is centred and scaled on the control cells, rotated onto the principal axes of the control cells, and every axis is scaled to unit variance on the control cells of each batch (the whitening); 5. CORAL aligns the control covariance of every batch to the pooled one (both regularised by ``coral_ridge`` times the identity).
records.label: spacr.ops_tvn#3
records.source: 1. columns with more than ``max_nonfinite`` non-finite values are dropped and the remaining gaps are filled with the column median; 2. every batch is centred and scaled on all of its cells; 3. a PCA keeping ``pca_variance`` of the variance is fitted on a random sample of ``pca_sample`` cells (seed ``seed``) and every cell is projected; 4. the projection is centred and scaled on the control cells, rotated onto the principal axes of the control cells, and every axis is scaled to unit variance on the control cells of each batch (the whitening); 5. CORAL aligns the control covariance of every batch to the pooled one (both regularised by ``coral_ridge`` times the identity).
records.translation: 1. colunas com mais de ``max_nonfinite`` valores não finitos são descartadas e as lacunas restantes são preenchidas com a mediana da coluna; 2. cada lote é centrado e escalado em todas as suas células; 3. uma PCA que mantém ``pca_variance`` da variância é ajustada em uma amostra aleatória de ``pca_sample`` células (semente ``seed``) e todas as células são projetadas; 4. a projeção é centrada e escalada nas células de controle, rotacionada para os eixos principais das células de controle, e cada eixo é escalado para variância unitária nas células de controle de cada lote (o branqueamento); 5. o CORAL alinha a covariância dos controles de cada lote à covariância combinada (ambas regularizadas por ``coral_ridge`` vezes a identidade).

records.context: Two implementations are given. :func:`tvn_in_memory` holds every cell at once, as Brieflow does. :func:`fit_tvn_streamed` reads one batch at a time and keeps only the control cells and a PCA sample, so a laboratory microplate or a pool of laboratory microplates never sits in memory; :meth:`TVNModel.transform` then applies the fitted model batch by batch.
records.label: spacr.ops_tvn#4
records.source: Two implementations are given. :func:`tvn_in_memory` holds every cell at once, as Brieflow does. :func:`fit_tvn_streamed` reads one batch at a time and keeps only the control cells and a PCA sample, so a plate or a pool of plates never sits in memory; :meth:`TVNModel.transform` then applies the fitted model batch by batch.
records.translation: Duas implementações são fornecidas. :func:`tvn_in_memory` mantém todas as células ao mesmo tempo, como faz o Brieflow. :func:`fit_tvn_streamed` lê um lote de cada vez e mantém apenas as células de controle e uma amostra de PCA, de modo que uma placa ou um conjunto de placas nunca fica em memória; :meth:`TVNModel.transform` aplica então o modelo ajustado lote a lote.

records.context: The whitening makes the low-variance tail sensitive to the PCA fit sample. Step 4 divides every axis by its control spread, so an axis that holds almost no control variance is blown up to the same weight as the first one. Which weak directions survive step 3 depends on the cells in the PCA sample, so two fits that differ only in that sample (or in the order the batches are read) agree on the strong axes but not on the tail.
